issues.concern: The gloss 'tax-exclusive price' is misleading. 外税 refers to the tax itself, or the system of adding tax separately, not the price.
issues.suggestion: tax not included in price; tax-exclusive

issues.concern: The gloss 'tax-exclusive, price before tax' is misleading. 外税 refers to the tax itself, or the system of adding tax separately, not the price.
issues.suggestion: tax not included in price; tax-exclusive
